# Decision log entry

> One entry per decision that needs a named approver but does not need a full ADR. If the decision is
> expensive to reverse, write an ADR instead and link it here.

## D-<nnn>: <short title>

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | Proposed / Accepted / Rejected / Superseded |
| Raised by | |
| Date raised | YYYY-MM-DD |
| Approver | Project Director |
| Decision owner | |
| Related | ADR-xxxx, IF-xxx, task id |

### Context

What is the situation, and why does it need a decision now? Include the constraint that makes the
choice non-obvious.

### Options

| # | Option | Pros | Cons |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | | | |
| 2 | | | |
| 3 | | | |

### Recommendation

Which option A4 recommends, and the one-sentence reason. State what would change the recommendation.

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
